assessment.summary: This is a review article titled 'Malaria-Transmitting Vectors Microbiota: Overview and Interactions With Anopheles Mosquito Biology' published in Frontiers in Microbiology in 2022. It summarizes existing literature on the viral, fungal, and bacterial diversity of Anopheles mosquitoes and their roles in vector competence and insecticide resistance.
